title: Throughput-Fidelity Horizon Probe for Config Rollback
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run a systematic evaluation and monitoring pipeline to map the throughput-vs-fidelity frontier across a compact sweep of batching and prefix/KV cache parameters, produce automated rollback guardrails, and implement a lightweight production shadowing probe (the "horizon probe") that can detect regression drift within 4 hours of deploy. This ticket builds the eval suites, thresholds, dashboards, and the canary/rollback decision logic to prevent configuration changes from introducing silent quality regressions while capturing the expected throughput gains.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible sweep harness that measures token latency, tokens/sec, 99th latency, and top-1 quality loss on the canonical regen testset
Defined pass/fail thresholds: max allowed quality delta per slice <= 1.5% absolute BLEU/EM-type equivalent on regen prompts, or <= 0.04 decrease in QA F1 depending on eval task
A monitoring dashboard with alerts for: slice-level quality regressions, unexpected latency increases, and cache hit-rate anomalies
Automated rollback rule implemented in rollout controller: if horizon probe detects median quality degradation > threshold for two consecutive 30-min windows, deploy auto-rollback
Canary/shadow experiment recipe documented and runbook present with links to PRs and dashboards
plan_steps: Design a compact experiment matrix (batch sizes, microbatch cap, prefix cache TTLs, prefix cache sharding) that covers 18 configurations (3x3x2)
Assemble representative eval sets: regen canonical set, user-simulated prefix-heavy set, few-shot long-context slice
Implement harness instrumentation to collect per-request: model config, token latency, conv-id, cache hit/miss, prompt fingerprint, quality score
Run offline sweep on staging with synthetic load that mimics production seq-lens and inter-arrival distributions
Analyze frontier: compute Pareto frontier of throughput vs fidelity and annotate candidate configs for release
Wire lightweight shadow probe in production (1% of traffic) to compare new-config outputs against baseline in near-real time
Add monitoring alerts and automated rollback logic in rollout controller; integrate with PagerDuty playbook
Document runbook and ship PRs for runtime, metrics, and dashboard updates
experiment_matrix: note: total configs=18 (3x3x2) after excluding invalid combos
monitoring: Create Grafana panel: throughput-fidelity scatter with selectable slices and color by cache hit rate
Alert rules: quality_delta_abs > configured_threshold for slice for 30m -> severity P1; cache_hit_rate drop >20% in 10m -> P0
Horizon probe: a short-lived shadow job that logs paired outputs and quality diffs to BigQuery for rolling-4h aggregation
rollout_plan: Stage: run full sweep on staging and pick 2 candidate configs (conservative and aggressive)
Canary: enable conservative config as 2% traffic for 2h with horizon probe collecting differences
Intermediate: if canary stable (no alerts), scale conservative to 20% over 24h
Aggressive trial: enable aggressive config to 1% shadow (no production responses) and compare against conservative baseline; if quality within thresholds, promote via gradual ramp
Automatic rollback: if horizon probe flags two consecutive windows of degradation or any P0 alert, rollback immediately and notify owners
